{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''residential building''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] contained a number of housing units. Around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Sigus family]] lived in the building's unit 2-A, the [[Sharlson family]] in unit 2-B, and the [[Kinalos]] family in unit 2-C. [[Hamedaw|"Old Man" Hamedaw]] was responsible for keeping the building clean. The building was located on an avenue lined with [[tchuspera]] bushes, and was near a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] called [[Ploover's]] and a [[School|lyceum]] with a [[Youngling/Legends|younglings']] playground.

During the [[Imperial Civil War]] that followed in the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the building and its environs were the site of [[Ground warfare/Legends|significant fighting]], and the ruins were occupied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]]. It was later cleared of Imperial forces by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] soldiers, among them a [[Kinalos|former resident]]. To deny it to Imperial forces, the building was burned by the New Republic shortly after it was cleared.
